bias.en: Uptrend broken · SAR flipped bearish, on the 200-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势受损 · SAR 转空，回到 200 日均线

read.en: TSMC fell 5.9% on Oct 30 to $406.13, trading between $400.12 and $418.09 on 1.9 times average volume. It is below the rising 5-day ($427.7) and 30-day ($443.2) and the falling 10-day ($424.7) and 100-day ($429.6), just above the rising 200-day ($400.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9, below zero, histogram widening again; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 30 ($440.88), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: 台积电 10月30日下跌 5.9%，收于 $406.13，盘中区间 $400.12–418.09，成交量为均量的 1.9 倍。股价位于上行的 5 日（$427.7）和 30 日均线（$443.2）以及下行的 10 日（$424.7）和 100 日均线（$429.6）下方，略高于上行的 200 日均线（$400.2）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图再度扩大；抛物线 SAR 于 10月30日转为看空（$440.88），RSI 为 38。

read.en: Two losses broke all three written supports, $436.8–438.6, $428.9–429.8 and $424.4–426.3, and flipped the SAR bearish. Resistance is $407.1–411.1 (Oct 15, 16, 22 and 23 lows), then $424.7–429.6 (5, 10 and 100-day) and $440.9 (Oct 28 high, SAR). Support is $405.2–405.5 (Aug 24 and Jun 9 lows), then $400.1–400.2 (200-day, Oct 30 low) and $381.3–386 (Jul 28 and Jul 17 lows). A close above $411 would target $425–430; below $400, $386.
